case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 969 OF 2023; SLP (C) No. 22337 of 2008; W.P.(C) No. 25/2021; T.C.(C) No. 16/2011
summary: Constitution Bench reference on legal education standards; questions concerning validity of AIBE and pre-enrolment requirements; overruling Sudeer precedent; Sections 24 and 49 powers affirmed; AIBE requirement upheld; post-enrolment examination permissible; mandatory bar exam enforced; disciplinary powers clarified; infrastructure compliance ordered.
final_judgment: Reference answered; Sudeer judgment overruled; AIBE requirement validated; pre-enrolment examination upheld as permissible; post-enrolment examination permitted; appeal allowed with directions for compliance.
